acceptanceCriteria: Priority admission considers waiting claims across stages: on a tie in priority, the earlier waiting claim wins, and a review/integrate claim for a ticket that other open tickets depend on is ranked ahead of a new implement claim.
The ranking is derived (no new stored state) and deterministic, consistent with the V1-0784 contract; the spec states the cross-stage rule.
`dispatch status` (or the claim result) exposes the waiting claims considered and the admission decision.
Maintained tests reproduce the reported order (review waiting, implement arrives, member frees) and show the review admitted.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#626 (orchestrator triage; reporter observations on main-2fff511, not reproduced yet).

With `pools[].priorityAdmission: true` (V1-0784), a freed member was allocated to a new implement claim while a longer-waiting review claim (both P0) was pending.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#632, merged to main as 265835f77f9aca1175dfeac06ee7e63ecf17a805. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0855-cross-stage-admission.md at that commit (the digest is that file's sha256), which records the change, the maintained tests the acceptance criteria name, the independent Codex review and its repairs. The batch head passed the doc gates, go vet, the full suites of the touched packages on darwin and every hosted CI check (go-product shards, doc-gates, go-interop). NOT_RUN: make gate, live multi-agent/dispatcher qualification and non-darwin execution where that entry says so.

title: corvint-tasks priorityAdmission: a waiting review-stage claim for a higher-urgency ticket loses the freed member to a new implement claim (issue #626)
